successors.name: Kidarites
successors.text: Cliopatria's Kidarite shape of 402 adds exactly the Xionite shape of 387-401

successors.name: Hephthalites (White Huns)
successors.text: Cliopatria's White Huns row begins in 410 with the same shape

ledger.x: 353: the Chionites of Grumbates raid the Sasanian frontier.
387: the Xionites take the Oxus strip from the Kidarites.
387: the Xionite shape reaches east to Ferghana and the Syr Darya.
387: the western and northern parts of Transoxiana fall outside Cliopatria's 387 shape, which is narrower there than the keyframe 353-386.

wars.name: Shapur II's war against the Chionites
wars.outcome: After a long struggle the war ended in 358 in a 'treaty alliance with the Chionites and the Gelani'; Grumbates then served Shapur II against Rome at the siege of Amida in 359, where his son was killed.

certainty.note: Nomads of Transoxiana: no frontier is named on either page; the 358 treaty alliance with Shapur II fixed no line.
